title: Leveraging Explainable Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) and Metabolomics for Robust Diagnosis and Pathophysiological Insights in Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (ME/CFS).
summary: TPOT reported AUC 92.1±1.9%, accuracy 87.3±2.3%, sensitivity 85.8±3.2%, specificity 89.0±2.6%; SHAP identified candidate features. These are associations/classification results, not causal mechanisms. TPOT, Auto-Sklearn and H2O AutoML searched pipelines on 888 metabolite/lipid features; SHAP was applied to the selected TPOT model. Methods describe 100 repeated 80/20 random train/test splits and 5-fold model selection within training. This is internal validation on one reused cohort; the paper does not establish external diagnostic performance. AutoML was applied to plasma metabolomics/lipidomics from 106 ME/CFS cases and 91 controls; TPOT had the highest reported internal AUC (92.1%) and SHAP-ranked candidate metabolites.
